verdict.rationale: The only evidence close to 'official SDKs' is a GitHub OpenAPI spec project that lets developers generate a client library for testing, not a maintained, documented set of official SDKs; the rest of the evidence covers REST API docs and an MCP/agent-toolkit for AI assistants, not language SDKs. missing for 10: documented official SDKs in specific languages (e.g. Java/Python/Node), SDK versioning/release notes, package registry listings, and independent confirmation of SDK usage.
